question:
The equation given below describes which law ?

 Emf=-N(Deltavarphi )/(Delta t)
solution:
The answer is **__Lenz’s law.__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Lenz law** was named after the Physicist **Emil Lenz**, and **formulated in 1834.**
 
• It is based on the principle of the **law of conservation of energy.**
 
• It states that** the direction of the electric current induced in a conductor by a changing magnetic field is such that the magnetic created by the induced current opposes the change in an initial magnetic field .**
 
• It is a quantitative law that **specifies the direction of induced current **but states nothing about its magnitude.
 
• This Law is applicable to **Generators, Electromagnetic Brakes, and Inductive Cockpits.​**
